jobs.title: Creative Producer
jobs.description:
Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system.

We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber.

We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers.

We're building our own in-house content and creative team. Unlike most companies, it won't sit inside marketing as another growth channel; it runs as its own function with one objective: to make Fuse, and the abundant future we're building, impossible to ignore. As a Creative Producer, you make our campaigns happen. You, the designers and art directors run as a tag team: they own the idea and the look, you own the intelligence and the delivery. Together you take a campaign from the first insight to the final file, and when we work with external partners, you find, brief and run them.

Responsibilities

Gather the insights campaigns are built on: competitor research, category research and what's working in culture right now
Brainstorm positioning and messaging with the head of content, art director, design and whichever teams the campaign touches
Find and assess external agencies and freelancers, and write the creative briefs they work from
Run production logistics: locations, scheduling, kit, and booking the talent and crew the art director has chosen
Own the shot list and asset plan before every shoot, so one shoot day yields many assets across ads, social and campaign
Work with social strategists and creators to plan the assets they need and roll each campaign out across platforms
On big hero films, act as in-house executive producer: commission and run the named freelance crew (director, DOP, colourist, sound) and own the budget
Keep every production moving so nothing stalls or slips

Requirements

Organisation: you run the logistics, schedule and budget and keep a shoot with many moving parts on the rails, arriving with the full asset plan and leaving with every asset in the can
Problem-solving under pressure: you hold the schedule and budget when things go wrong on shoots, and protect the creative while you solve it
3+ years as a producer, with real strategic curiosity, a range of produced video and campaigns, and strong management of crews, vendors and agencies

Benefits

Competitive salary and eligibility for equity
Biannual bonus scheme
Fully expensed tech to match your needs
Private health insurance
Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

Why Authentic

You’ll be able to access the resources and scale, while leveraging innovative technology and nimble environment. What we’re saying is, this isn’t your average day job. If you’re hungry to drive ideas into action and own your career, let’s chat. Our team is rapidly innovating to evolve and define the future of our brands. With the help of some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more, we are building the intersection of digital and experiential marketing to help achieve that mission. We reimagine, evolve and transform brands! At Authentic, we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought and expertise drive competitive advantage. Our global teams are built by go-getters who contribute unique perspectives and push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.
  What You’ll Do

We are looking for an experienced Senior Creative to support the ideation, production and delivery of creative assets across all activities, products and partnerships associated with the David Beckham brand.
The role will work closely with Authentic’s VP, Creative Director, acting as a key creative partner. You will help shape creative direction, develop ideas and oversee the delivery of high-quality content across social, digital, editorial, campaigns and brand partner channels.

You will be confident stepping up to lead projects, provide creative direction and represent the creative function when the VP, Creative Director is unavailable.
The role requires a keen eye for detail and strong aesthetic appreciation. The range of brand partnerships spans fashion, sport, automotive, philanthropic and lifestyle, with each requiring a unique sensibility and approach. Across every partnership, the highest level of care and attention is required, with every asset viewed on a global stage.
From social-first content to ATL campaigns, the level of creative ambition and attention to detail remains consistent, maintaining a best-in-class creative aesthetic across all output.
The role will help manage and evolve the creative process, fostering strong collaboration across internal teams, commercial partners, production teams, editorial and external creative talent. This encompasses digital, social, print, moving image, stills and product.
This is an opportunity for a highly capable senior creative to play a central role within a dynamic, creative and entrepreneurial environment, working across a diverse portfolio of global opportunities.

Partner closely with the VP, Creative Director to develop and deliver the overall creative vision for the David Beckham brand and its partnerships, deputising and taking creative ownership where required.
Lead day-to-day creative development and execution across campaigns, social, editorial, digital, film, photography and commercial partnerships.
Maintain a best-in-class creative standard, facilitating ideation and content creation internally and externally, ensuring consistency, quality and continued elevation of the David Beckham brand.
Provide creative direction across look and feel, art direction, retouching and overall content output, working closely with a variety of production/ creative agencies and in-house creative brand partners.
Work closely with the Brand Partnerships team to shape concepts for social media and commercial campaigns, translating ideas into effective 360° creative executions.
Take ownership of projects from brief through to execution, ensuring creative quality, timelines and partner requirements are effectively managed.
Provide creative leadership and direction to internal teams and external creative partners, helping to get the best from multidisciplinary teams and high-profile talent.
Contribute creative thinking to new business development and partnership opportunities.
Oversee design output, including client presentations, and ensure effective organisation and filing of creative assets.
Build and maintain a network of high-level creative talent, including directors/ photographers/ editors, scriptwriters, DOPs and other creative specialists, bringing fresh thinking and expertise into the business.
Stay ahead of current and emerging trends across photography, fashion, lifestyle, film and social media, bringing relevant global perspectives and new approaches into the work.

Must Haves

8-10 years’ experience in a Senior Creative or similar role.
Strong experience in art direction within an advertising or creative agency, with high-level editorial experience across fashion, sport and/or lifestyle.
A highly creative thinker with the ability to generate, develop and articulate strong ideas.
Ability to shape creative concepts around brand and partner objectives, existing brand DNA, audience, cultural context and emerging trends.
Proven ability to lead creative projects from brief through to execution, with strong knowledge of creative references, research and trends.
Strong aesthetic judgement and an elevated visual point of view, with a passion for exceptional creative output.
Experience leading and collaborating with multidisciplinary creative teams and high-profile talent.
Strong experience across social media, film, photography, scripts and broader content production.
Good level of image retouching and video editing skills.
Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume content environment, particularly across social and digital.
Confident stepping into a leadership role, providing creative direction and deputising for senior creative leadership when required.
Able to get things done quickly in a dynamic/entrepreneurial environment.

jobs.description:
Interested in joining Blue State's Creative Director team? Submit your application here to ensure you're first in line for future opportunities. Please note: this is an "evergreen" job post (i.e. not an active job post), but your expression of interest matters to us. While interviews aren't ongoing, we're excited to connect with talented individuals who share our commitment to Blue State's mission.

If you came across this job via LinkedIn, please note that it is an evergreen role; Linked In does not differentiate, but we prefer to.

What to know

Create compelling campaigns, brands and experiences for causes that matter. In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we’re delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands’ social impact teams.

We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We’re looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking.

We’re interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

The company

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

A day in the life

Lead and inspire:
Working closely with your colleagues, you’ll develop a vision for our client’s creative success. You’ll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.
Create with purpose:
Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality.
Accountability:
Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects.
Foster a culture of collaboration and creativity:
Stay on top of developments in the field, industry, and culture. Help identify, hire and retain designers, copywriters, and other creatives. Mentor junior members of the project team.

What we offer

Unlimited time off (inclusive of sick, personal and vacation days)
$1,000 annual in professional development funds (local equivalent)
Fully subsidised health and dental insurance for employees (subject to tax)
Generous pension match via salary sacrifice
Generous paid holiday schedule
Parental leave policy for up to 32.5 week of coverage at full pay, inclusive of all genders and supporting a range of family structures
Group Income Protection (GIP)
Group Life Assurance (GLA)
Optional holiday travel insurance
Pre-tax season ticket loans
Cycle to work (up to £2000)
Remote work flexibility

We approach in-office working with a hybrid model, with presence in our office required at two days per week.

The team

You’ll be a senior member of the London team bringing in new clients and, as a leader, defining and improving the work we’re creating. You will also be a part of our global creative director team who meet regularly for creative inspiration.

Some things we're looking for

6+ years in senior creative role, ideally with hands-on designing experience. At least some of this experience working on fundraising and mobilisation campaigns.
Experience in leading and collaborating with teams of designers, copywriters, strategists and creatives - taking insight that has been shaped and developing compelling, digitally-driven ideas and products.
Strategy-led: able to clearly articulate design or strategy related dilemmas, and offer multiple solutions with a clear link back to the strategy and insights.
Comfort and passion for creative testing, co-creation with clients and audiences, and constructively consolidating feedback from global stakeholders to improve the work.
Impeccable presentation skills: able to explain the reasons behind a particular design or creative strategy, and guide clients through difficult decision points. Experience in pitching a strong advantage.
Deep knowledge of persuasion strategies & tools: copywriting, social influence, brand advocacy, fundraising, UX and experience design.
Strong sense of communications and its operating model: how impactful messages are created, journeys constructed and users driven on a journey from awareness to advocacy.
An area of expertise or passion in the design world (be it fundraising, design, UX, communications or social change) that you can harness and upskill wider team members with as a thought leader within the wider company.

Location: Barcelona

About Us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.
We bridge digital and creative thinking, developing innovative work across skincare, healthcare, fashion, lifestyle, FMCG, and more. Our international teams in the US and Barcelona deliver results through smart strategy, sharp creativity, and meticulous execution.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong conceptual thinking, great visual taste and experience working across global wellness and lifestyle brands.
Someone who can move comfortably between product and lifestyle, science and culture, and who understands how creative needs to work across the full consumer journey.
You might be working on a product with a complex ingredient or efficacy story one day, developing a talent-led campaign the next, and figuring out how that same brand idea translates into more product-focused or conversion-driven work further down the funnel.
This is a global role, so we’re looking for someone who is comfortable developing ideas that can travel across markets and cultures without becoming generic.
You’ll lead creative development across global wellness, beauty-adjacent and lifestyle brands, from early concepts and campaign platforms through to production and execution.
We’re looking for someone who cares about the idea as much as the craft, but also understands what the creative is there to do.
You’ll work hand in hand with Strategy, as well as Copy, Design, Social and Production, to understand the audience, cultural context, role of each channel and each stage of the funnel, and translate that thinking into strong creative.
This isn’t purely an art direction role. You need to be able to come up with strong campaign ideas, build on other people’s ideas and turn them into something bigger.

Key Responsibilities

Develop strong global campaign ideas and creative platforms that can live across markets, channels and executions.
Partner closely with strategists from the beginning of the process, challenging and building on briefs rather than simply receiving them.
Understand the role creative plays across the full funnel, from building awareness and brand desire to communicating product benefits, driving consideration and supporting conversion.
Know when an execution needs to build the brand, when it needs to explain the product and when it simply needs to make someone want it.
Turn strategy, product benefits and consumer insights into simple, relevant creative ideas.
Build global creative platforms that have a clear central idea while leaving enough room for markets to make them culturally relevant.
Lead the visual direction of brands across product, lifestyle, talent and culture-led work.
Find interesting ways to communicate ingredients, efficacy, innovation and science without everything suddenly looking clinical.
Make products feel desirable through photography, film, CGI, design, casting, styling and storytelling.
Bring product and lifestyle together naturally, rather than creating a beautiful lifestyle campaign and remembering the product at the end.
Develop ideas around talent, creators, partnerships and cultural moments that make sense for the brand and the market.
Think beyond traditional campaign formats and identify opportunities across social, experiences, collaborations, entertainment and emerging culture.
Lead work from concept through production, keeping the original idea and level of craft intact along the way.
Present and sell creative thinking to senior clients and stakeholders across different markets.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary and international creative teams.

What we’re looking for

A Creative Director who is conceptually strong and visually sophisticated, with a portfolio that shows range.
Big campaign thinking
Ideas with a clear point of view that can become genuine global platforms, not just a collection of executions.
Strong visual taste
A great eye for photography, film, casting, styling, design and contemporary brand aesthetics.
Product storytelling
Experience making products, ingredients, technology or benefits interesting and desirable, especially when there’s real science or efficacy behind them.
Full-funnel creative thinking
An understanding of how people move from discovering a brand to considering and buying it, and how the creative job changes along the way.
Strong creative + strategy partnership
Someone who likes working closely with strategists, has a point of view on the brief and knows how to turn strategic thinking into creative opportunities.
Global thinking
Experience developing work for multiple markets and understanding the difference between a global idea and simply making the same campaign appear everywhere. You should be comfortable collaborating with local teams and adapting ideas around different cultural behaviors and audiences without losing the core creative thought.
Lifestyle and culture
Work that shows an understanding of how brands can play in culture through talent, creators, collaborations, social, entertainment and experiences.
Range
We want someone who can create a beautiful product or efficacy story and then switch gears into a culturally relevant lifestyle campaign without either feeling forced.

Key Requirements

10+ years of creative experience, ideally across agencies and/or ambitious consumer brands.
Significant experience working on global brands and international campaigns.
Experience leading integrated and full-funnel campaigns, from brand-building through product and conversion-focused creative.
Background in wellness, beauty, personal care, lifestyle, premium CPG or adjacent categories.
Experience working closely with Strategy on audiences, consumer journeys, cultural insights and creative briefs.
Experience working with product claims, ingredients, efficacy or science-led briefs is a plus.
Strong photography and film production experience.
Experience working with talent, creators or culturally driven campaigns.
Experience leading multidisciplinary and international creative teams.
Excellent client-facing and presentation skills.
Native or near-native English, or equivalent professional fluency developed through extensive experience working in English. This person needs to be able to concept, debate, present and sell creative ideas confidently in English with senior global clients and teams.

Portfolio

We want to see ideas, taste and range.
Showcase strong campaigns, as well as activations, social ideas, collaborations and product experiences that demonstrate different ways brands can connect with people.
We want to see work that feels relevant to its audience, where the product matters and the visual execution is strong.

Languages

English (mandatory)
Spanish (preferably)
Any other languages are a plus.

What we offer

Remote flex Fridays from 9:00 AM to 2.30 PM.
Three weeks of remote work per year.
Summer working hours across July and August (9:00 AM to 4.00 PM).
Free English & Spanish classes to boost your global communication skills.
Access to Wellhub, a wellness platform offering a wide range of fitness and wellbeing options.
Flexible retribution plan for meals, transport and childcare.
Holidays: 22 working days + 3 days established by the collective agreement + national and local public holidays.
Bright, spacious offices in the heart of Barcelona.
Competitive salary with real growth opportunities.
A global environment, cutting-edge tools, and a culture driven by trends and innovation.

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

Great creative starts with a sharp idea, and the earlier it arrives, the better the work gets. As our Creative Strategist & Producer, you bring ideas in at the start of a campaign and you can also make them. Up to half the role is writing complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, and sometimes organic and social, then briefing them into our creatives and designers. The other half is making work yourself, in whatever format you’re strongest at. You also help Product Marketing and Performance Marketing write stronger briefs of their own.

This role is for a proactive self-starter. Nobody will hand you the idea: you go and find it, pitch it and get it made.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. You work daily with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, who bring deep knowledge of the product and the media channels, and with the creatives who bring your briefs to life.

Spot opportunities in culture every day. Watch pop culture, trends, competitors, comments and performance data, and turn what you find into ideas we ship the same week. Stay close to financial markets and to Kraken’s audience.
Write complete, concept-led briefs for paid static and motion, built with Product Marketing and Performance Marketing, and brief them into the performance creatives and designers.

Use performance data and social listening as creative input, and get more distinct angles into tests each month.Performance Marketing owns test design and readouts; you own the creative response.
React inside the news cycle. You spot the moment, and you brief it or make it yourself.
Partner with Product Marketing and compliance to get work approved without losing the idea.
Keep your briefs and files clean enough for other people to build on.

What You Bring

5+ years in creative strategy, social, content or performance creative at a high-volume in-house team, brand or agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.
A portfolio submitted with your application. Include two or three concept-led briefs or concept decks, with what shipped and how it performed where you’re able to share it, plus work you made yourself in the formats that are your strength. Pop-culture fluency and a chronically online persona, with comedic instinct and a sense for what’s about to feel dated.
A performance marketer’s grip on what a good brief needs: a clear objective, audience, hook, platform, format and set of constraints, and the ability to coach others toward it.
A creative superpower you can execute on alone, with shipped work to show for it.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Reddit and X. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Fluency in the metrics creative moves, and the habit of using performance data and social listening as inputs to ideas.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with concepts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

Who We Are

Authentic Brands Group (Authentic) is a global brand and entertainment platform that owns and invests in iconic intellectual property and cultural assets. It accelerates brands through a set of specialized businesses that combine powerful storytelling, premium content, unforgettable live experiences and global commerce. Through a network of more than 1,700 best-in-class licensees and strategic partners across 150 countries and expansive distribution, Authentic’s brands drive more than $38 billion in annual systemwide retail sales worldwide. Authentic’s diversified portfolio spans more than 50 brands and reaches nearly one billion social media followers. Its roster includes Reebok, Champion, Shaquille O’Neal, David Beckham, Kevin Hart, Sports Illustrated, Elvis Presley, Muhammad Ali, Marilyn Monroe, GUESS, Aéropostale, Nautica, Eddie Bauer, Lucky Brand, Nine West, Brooks Brothers, Juicy Couture, Vince Camuto, Izod, Van Heusen, Dockers, Ted Baker, Hart Schaffner Marx, Vince, Barneys New York, Judith Leiber, Quiksilver, Spyder, Billabong, Volcom, Roxy, RVCA, DC Shoes, Prince, Sperry and Hunter. For more information, visit corporate.authentic.com. Follow Authentic on LinkedIn, Instagram and WeChat.
Why Authentic

You’ll be able to access the resources and scale, while leveraging innovative technology and nimble environment. What we’re saying is, this isn’t your average day job. If you’re hungry to drive ideas into action and own your career, let’s chat. Our team is rapidly innovating to evolve and define the future of our brands. With the help of some of the brightest minds in retail, marketing, licensing, legal and more, we are building the intersection of digital and experiential marketing to help achieve that mission. We reimagine, evolve and transform brands! At Authentic, we foster an inclusive workplace where diversity of thought and expertise drive competitive advantage. Our global teams are built by go-getters who contribute unique perspectives and push the boundaries of creativity and innovation. Headquartered in New York City, Authentic has offices in major metropolitan cities including Los Angeles and Miami, as well as Toronto, Mexico City, London, and Shanghai.
  What You’ll Do

We are looking for an experienced Senior Creative to support the ideation, production and delivery of creative assets across all activities, products and partnerships associated with the David Beckham brand.
The role will work closely with Authentic’s VP, Creative Director, acting as a key creative partner. You will help shape creative direction, develop ideas and oversee the delivery of high-quality content across social, digital, editorial, campaigns and brand partner channels.
A key part of the role will be taking ownership of the day-to-day creative process, ensuring work is delivered to the highest standard and in line with the David Beckham brand. You will be confident stepping up to lead projects, provide creative direction and represent the creative function when the VP, Creative Director is unavailable.
The role requires a keen eye for detail and strong aesthetic appreciation. The range of brand partnerships spans fashion, sport, automotive, philanthropic and lifestyle, with each requiring a unique sensibility and approach. Across every partnership, the highest level of care and attention is required, with every asset viewed on a global stage.
From social-first content to ATL campaigns, the level of creative ambition and attention to detail remains consistent, maintaining a best-in-class creative aesthetic across all output.
The role will help manage and evolve the creative process, fostering strong collaboration across internal teams, commercial partners, production teams, editorial and external creative talent. This encompasses digital, social, print, moving image, stills and product.
This is an opportunity for a highly capable senior creative to play a central role within a dynamic, creative and entrepreneurial environment, working across a diverse portfolio of global opportunities.
What You’ll Be Working On

Partner closely with the VP, Creative Director to develop and deliver the overall creative vision for the David Beckham brand and its partnerships, deputising and taking creative ownership where required.
Lead day-to-day creative development and execution across campaigns, social, editorial, digital, film, photography and commercial partnerships.
Maintain a best-in-class creative standard, facilitating ideation and content creation internally and externally, ensuring consistency, quality and continued elevation of the David Beckham brand.
Provide creative direction across look and feel, art direction, retouching and overall content output, working closely with a variety of production/ creative agencies and in-house creative brand partners.
Work closely with the Brand Partnerships team to shape concepts for social media and commercial campaigns, translating ideas into effective 360° creative executions.
Take ownership of projects from brief through to execution, ensuring creative quality, timelines and partner requirements are effectively managed.
Provide creative leadership and direction to internal teams and external creative partners, helping to get the best from multidisciplinary teams and high-profile talent.
Contribute creative thinking to new business development and partnership opportunities.
Oversee design output, including client presentations, and ensure effective organisation and filing of creative assets.
Build and maintain a network of high-level creative talent, including directors/ photographers/ editors, scriptwriters, DOPs and other creative specialists, bringing fresh thinking and expertise into the business.
Stay ahead of current and emerging trends across photography, fashion, lifestyle, film and social media, bringing relevant global perspectives and new approaches into the work.

Must Haves

8-10 years’ experience in a Senior Creative or similar role.
Strong experience in art direction within an advertising or creative agency, with high-level editorial experience across fashion, sport and/or lifestyle.
A highly creative thinker with the ability to generate, develop and articulate strong ideas.
Ability to shape creative concepts around brand and partner objectives, existing brand DNA, audience, cultural context and emerging trends.
Proven ability to lead creative projects from brief through to execution, with strong knowledge of creative references, research and trends.
Strong aesthetic judgement and an elevated visual point of view, with a passion for exceptional creative output.
Experience leading and collaborating with multidisciplinary creative teams and high-profile talent.
Strong experience across social media, film, photography, scripts and broader content production.
Good level of image retouching and video editing skills.
Experience working in a fast-paced, high-volume content environment, particularly across social and digital.
Confident stepping into a leadership role, providing creative direction and deputising for senior creative leadership when required.
Able to get things done quickly in a dynamic/entrepreneurial environment.
Technical proficiency in design applications / BA or equivalent in Graphic Design / Adobe Creative Suite / Keynote.
Time management skills / Attention to detail / well organised.
